title: Know your numbers
headline: Know your *numbers*
sub: Your business in one card, every morning.

recap.en: It is eight in the morning. Ikenna opens Taskiem.
recap.pcm: Na eight for morning. Ikenna open Taskiem.

bridge.en: Phones are valuable, and so are the payments. How does Ikenna keep it safe?
bridge.pcm: Phones get value, payments too. How Ikenna go keep am safe?

flow.action: Sips a cup of tea at the counter before he rolls up the shutter, reads his phone, and his brows lift as the numbers appear
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

flow.action: Looks up from his phone with a quiet proud grin and nods once
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

en: Owed, a count of low items, and deliveries.
Later, he types briefing, and the card comes back.
And Today shows the day so far.
pcm: Wetin dem owe am, items wey low, deliveries.
Later, he type briefing, and the card come back.
And Today show the day so far.
